_comment: Outcome of the 2026-10 discovery pass for inspected candidates. 'match' lists exact lower-case fragments of a candidate's DOI or URL (never a bare word of a title). A decision no harvested candidate matches is added to the inventory as a 'direct-search' candidate. inventory.py applies these as the candidate's status.

decisions.title: Canmore — National Record of the Historic Environment (points)
decisions.note: 174,054 records dated from ScAPA periods, centuries or years; undated generic records stay out of the index.

decisions.title: Archaeological Survey of Ireland — Sites and Monuments Record
decisions.note: 56,074 records; dated only where the monument class itself names a period (3,575).

decisions.title: Rejestr zabytków nieruchomych (NID, dane.gov.pl)
decisions.note: Construction windows parsed from 'chronologia'; placed at locality level (the register has no coordinates).

decisions.title: Index Villaris 1680 (John Adams), digital edition
decisions.note: Snapshot 1680 — listed in that year; beginning and end unknown.

decisions.title: Ottoman natural features and settlements gazetteer (NFS)
decisions.note: Snapshot per tax register (hijri → CE).

decisions.title: Gazetteer_Generalkarte von Mitteleuropa
decisions.note: Envelope 1880–1918; lat/lon columns swapped in the source, corrected.

decisions.title: The 18th century Cassini roads and cities dataset
decisions.note: Places and roads, envelope 1756–1815.

decisions.title: Settlements … on the Lutsch map of Transylvania (1751)
decisions.note: Snapshot 1751.

decisions.title: LIST — Latin Inscriptions in Space and Time v1.2
decisions.note: Per find-spot and century, only inscriptions dated to ≤150 years.

decisions.title: Register nepremične kulturne dediščine (RKD), Slovenia
decisions.note: Register dating per record: construction period for buildings, period of use for sites.

decisions.title: Engel Pál, Magyarország a középkor végén (2020)
decisions.note: Database encrypted inside a Windows GIS program; needs the institute's cooperation.

decisions.title: Euratlas Periodical Historical Atlas (Harvard Geospatial Library copy)
decisions.note: Harvard copy is Restricted; a commercial licence exists — not bought without the user.

decisions.title: Epigraphic Database Heidelberg (site)
decisions.note: Site behind a bot wall; its content reached through LIST (EDH + EDCS).

decisions.title: Main roads and mountain paths on the Lutsch map of Transylvania (1751)
decisions.note: 43 roads/paths, snapshot 1751, in the dated-map roads layer.

decisions.title: Latvia: list of state-protected immovable monuments
decisions.note: List dating per record (centuries, years, archaeological periods); placed at town/village/parish via GeoNames (no coordinates in the list). CC0.

decisions.title: Croatia: Register of cultural goods
decisions.note: Register dating per record ('A do B'); placed at the named settlement via GeoNames. Open Licence (HR).

decisions.title: Czechia: Památkový katalog open data (KP / NKP lists)
decisions.note: No dating field and no coordinates; dates appear only in free-text annotations — not used, to avoid inventing dates.

decisions.title: Portugal: SRUP Imóveis Classificados (DGT WFS)
decisions.note: Coordinates but only the date of the protection decree, not of the building — no usable historical dating.

decisions.title: Estonia (register.muinas.ee) and Lithuania (kvr.kpd.lt) heritage registers
decisions.note: Bot wall (403) from this machine; no bulk dataset found on andmed.eesti.ee or data.gov.lt.

decisions.title: German Historical GIS (HGIS Germany) boundaries 1820–1914 (Harvard Geospatial Library)
decisions.note: Public in the catalogue but Harvard returns 429 to this machine; licence is non-commercial academic → private pack once downloaded.

decisions.title: Gazetteer_Russian-3verst_map (Boykov) — Balkans
decisions.note: Envelope 1877–1879 (survey); lat/lon columns exchanged in the source, corrected.

decisions.title: RoHGIS. Settlements in the Kingdom of Romania (1904-1913)
decisions.note: Every settlement existing 1904–1913.

decisions.title: Rise and fall of transhumance in Iceland: Shielings and related sites (TransIce)
decisions.note: Farms: 1703 snapshot (Jarðabók); shielings: first mention / abandonment years.

decisions.title: DISSILOC: places in medieval inquisition registers
decisions.note: Attested in register years taken from each edition title; Stettin register undated.

decisions.title: Sweden: older geometrical maps 1630–1655
decisions.note: Settlement units, churches, mills drawn on the 1630–1655 maps; shown for that survey window.

decisions.title: Sweden: younger geometrical maps 1680–1700
decisions.note: HTML transcriptions without coordinates — would need linking to places first.

decisions.title: Historical Place Gazetteer and Mine Register, Tyrol 15th–16th c.
decisions.note: Attested in document years (Hs. 37 1460–1463; Hs. 1587 c. 1515).

decisions.title: Ottoman Gazetteer (Hanley), incl. 1530 place names
decisions.note: 1530 register names without coordinates; CC BY-NC. Geocoding Ottoman names to modern places would be guesswork.

decisions.title: World Historical Gazetteer contributed datasets (e.g. List of Russian towns late 14c, Benjamin of Tudela, Heritage Gazetteer of Libya)
decisions.note: WHG now answers 'Bot access denied'; no WHG token in this environment.

decisions.title: Syria town database (2004 census)
decisions.note: Modern census — not historical.

decisions.title: Replication Data for: Warfare and Welfare in Colonial Algeria
decisions.note: Aggregate tables, no places.

decisions.title: Portugal population 1527–1864 (Palma, Reis, Zhang)
decisions.note: Regional population tables; would need historical region polygons.

decisions.title: Public georeferenced historical maps (Harvard Geospatial Library and other OpenGeoMetadata catalogues)
decisions.note: 1,052 public georeferenced scans indexed (year, extent, WMS) and offered as overlays in the map archive.

decisions.title: Arkas 2.0 — archaeological sites of Slovenia (ZRC SAZU)
decisions.note: Each site's own dating in years (Leto_od/Leto_do); 3,684 sites in 1–1914.

decisions.title: Database of northeastern African archaeological and heritage sites (Marmarica)
decisions.note: 3,355 sites but 3,214 'Undetermined'; the ~190 dated ones carry only named periods without years.

decisions.title: Slovakia: Atlas of the Landscape monuments layers (SAŽP WFS)
decisions.note: Points with category only — no names, no dates.

decisions.title: ARIADNE portal — European archaeology catalogue (records with PeriodO-linked periods)
decisions.region: Iceland, Hungary, Finland, Austria, Germany, Bulgaria, Portugal and others
decisions.note: Harvested per country (API: 50/page, 10,000/query). Hungary, above the window, harvested by one text query per GeoNames municipality/town name (8,855 names in 3 resumable slices; completed 2026-10-01). Each phase keeps its own period; records without a point placed at their municipality only when the name is unique (2,638 left out). 63,354 dated records in the pack. Provider licences vary (e.g. Ísleif CC BY-NC-ND) → private pack.

decisions.title: Atlas of the Latin Church in the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth c. 1772 (IHGK Lublin)
decisions.note: 7,715 churches and 1,327 religious houses as a 1772 snapshot; EPSG:3857 coordinates converted; CC BY-NC → private pack.

decisions.title: Archaeological sites of wine and olive oil production in Hispania (CSUC Dataverse)
decisions.note: CSUC Dataverse answers with an Anubis bot wall from this machine. Retry from a browser.

decisions.title: Historical Urban Population 3700 BC – AD 2000 (Reba, Reitsma & Seto; Harvard Dataverse copy)
decisions.note: CC BY, but the download requires a guestbook response (name, email); not submitted without the user's consent. SEDAC copy needs an Earthdata login.

decisions.title: Stadestér 1.0 — global database of 41,000+ cities
decisions.note: Rejected: populations cubic-spline interpolated to annual values — manufactured precision, not source estimates.

decisions.title: Mid-19th-century building structures in Galicia and Austrian Silesia (Second Military Survey)
decisions.note: 1.3 M individual building points (c. 1850s survey), not named places — queued for a building-density layer.

decisions.title: Archaeological sites in the Trajan's Gate Pass, Bulgaria
decisions.note: Inspected 2026-10-01 (tgp.zip, CC BY 4.0, kept in the raw vault): 15 sites (inns, villages, a fortress) dated by century, several marked uncertain (?), plus an undated Ottoman road trace Ihtiman–Plovdiv. Too small to change any coverage cell; not integrated for now.

decisions.title: AMCR — Archaeological Map of the Czech Republic (Archeologický informační systém ČR)
decisions.note: Found by the automated investigation (92 of its document records surfaced as candidates). Open OAI-PMH API, CC BY-NC 4.0 → private pack. 11,042 sites and 236,259 fieldwork events, each split into components with an AMCR period whose years come from its PeriodO-linked vocabulary (e.g. Early Middle Hillfort Period 801–850); 268,599 spatial units (PIAN) with geometry; 18,376 individual finds. Harvest started 2026-10-01 (fetch_oai.py, resumable).
